title: Travis's Oceanic Biomes
description: Adds more oceanic biomes to your world!
body:
# Da ocean is upgraded!

Arggg mate! lets go swimmin in these new oceanic biomes!

## Note from your's truly

Say hello to these new oceanic biomes created by yours truly, no no like if you dont understand its me-

# Lushy Kelp Forest
The lushy kelp forest is a... very lush kelp fore-

## Algae Estuary 
The algae estuary is basically its name but also home to this cute feller called the Pleco!
(the pleco loves algae but i cant get it so he eats it)

## The Sunken Forest
A long time ago a forest used to thrive here, and it still does!

## The Cold Reef
This place is home to Coral and some weird.. bones? ehuh but onto the next one

## The Warm Beach
The Warm Beach is a hot beach with lushness and water everywhere, and some cactus too!

### Thats just about it!
uhhh yeah thats it i dont got anything to say soo uhh yeah thanks for downloading if you downloaded this mod!
